purpose: Research-only public Binance USD-M perpetual observations for paper simulation validation
restrictions: No trading, authentication, private API, or account data accessed.
No fapi endpoint retry, network change, proxy, or access-control workaround used.
All official data below was read from signed-out rendered Binance UI.

procedure: Open public futures page, wait for rendered client-side hydration by reading AX state; verify contract heading and Perp label.
Read Last, Mark, Index, funding interval/rate/countdown, Open Interest(USDT), book, and tape as UI snapshots.
For candles choose Original and 1H. Use fresh screenshot to locate the previous candle; a one-pixel drag produces historical OHLC text in AX.
For statistics open the observed Open Interest(USDT) link. Verify selected symbol dropdown, then choose 1h.
Use fresh screenshot to locate latest and preceding OI bar/point; a one-pixel drag renders exact tooltip text into AX.
Scroll to Taker Buy/Sell Volume and use a fresh screenshot and one-pixel drag on latest completed bar.
Verify source symbol in dropdown AND tooltip units after each symbol change. Changing symbol resets interval to 5m; URL may retain previous contract.
collection_route.automation_status: Manual UI collection verified; no unattended collector or execution bridge established.

timezone_evidence.scope: Explicit TradingView chart clock on same Binance futures page.
timezone_evidence.caveat: Original-chart and statistics UI labels share the same apparent local-clock convention, but exchange timestamps are deliberately not synthesized from this inference.

remaining_validation: Exact venue event timestamps must be available and verified before an execution bridge is eligible.
Validate book synchronization, depth and quantity precision.
Validate historical candle window and feature requirements.
Validate unattended collector and source staleness handling; this is one bounded manual research collection.
